You can view all your bookings anytime by logging into your “My Account” . 2. We facilitate and make bookings on the Internet – we do not own or operate properties. 3. We are simply the best booking engine on the planet! 4. Please consult the description of the properties on our site to become familiar with their facilities, services, and the policies that rule them. It is the properties' responsibility to maintain this information accurate and current. 5. In case of a no show, the hostel has the right to charge your credit card the no show fee as per their cancellation policy. 6. Every effort is made to ensure that your booking is processed correctly by the hostel. 7. Please note that the service evaluations found on this website reflect the opinions of people who have stayed at the properties. We assume no responsibility for the opinions expressed. More than 250,000 people each month make reservations using this service. It works! How do you protect my information? Your personal information is stored in a fully secured server. This information is only accessible to associates who manage our distribution list of customers who wish to receive our newsletter emails. The newsletters that we send you contain an unsubscribe link. You can remove yourself from our newsletter distribution list anytime by clicking on the unsubscribe link. This charter may be amended any time at our discretion. We will post updates to this page accordingly. If you have any questions or concerns regarding our privacy policy, please feel free to contact us. Do I need to have or buy a yearly membership Hostel Card to book a hostel on this site? No. You do not have to have or buy a yearly hostel membership card to book at any hostel listed on our site. If a card is required by a hostel, you will be able to buy it at the hostel upon arrival. We do not sell any membership card How do I make a reservation? You need a valid credit card to process your reservation. We accept Visa, Visa Delta, Visa Electron and MasterCard credit cards and Solo, Switch, JCB and Laser. We do not accept American Express. The credit card must have sufficient funds to pay for the deposit. After you select your destination and enter you dates, a list of available hostels will show. Pick the hostel of your choice, then enter the number of people in the type of room you wish to reserve. After this, press "book now" and the system will ask you to enter the credit card information and then to confirm the reservation. Once you click on the “confirm” button, the system will process the transaction and then send you the confirmation record by email. The process takes less than a minute. Be patient – do not click the button “confirm” more than once to avoid making duplicate bookings. If you don’t find the confirmation email in your inbox, look for it in the “junk mail” folder as it may have been screened by the spam filter. If you do not find it, please email us with last four digits of your card, an screenshot of the charge in your bank and the property name you were trying to book. Depending on the property and the rate you booked, you should pay nothing at the moment of the booking, a deposit or the full amount of the deposit. If there is a balance payment, it could be charged before arrival or upon arrival depending on the rate conditions. You will know about this during your booking process. Is there anything else that I should do with my reservation before my arrival to the property? We suggest that you contact the hostel 24 hours before your scheduled arrival to confirm your reservation and your estimated time of arrival. If you plan to arrive after the check-in time posted on the hostel’s description on our website, please ensure that the hostel knows this so they do not cancel your reservation. Always mention the booking reference number in all correspondence with the hostel. Some properties will ask for pre check in procedures before arrival, if you are contacted about this, please follow their instructions. Which is the maximum number of nights I can book? You can book up to 30 nights in any hostel as long as there is availability. If I travel with young children, should I reserve a private bedroom for us? We recommend that you reserve a private bedroom for you and your young children. Please review the hostel’s policies regarding children and extra beds if required in the description of the property on our website. Not all the properties accept minors so please make sure you are clear about the age restrictions in the property you are booking. If have any question, feel free to contact us. What are the restrictions in terms of age? Most hostels do not have age restrictions. If they do, they will include this information in their description in our website. A typical restriction could be "Guest should be at least 18 years old to check in" Please take in consideration that in some countries, age restriction could also applied especially when we talk about shared rooms. So read well all the information before booking to avoid issues with your booking. Is it safe to use my credit card on this site? Of course! We use the latest SSL technology. All information is encrypted and secure. it is very safe. Do I need a credit card to make a reservation? You must have a valid credit card to book a reservation. We accept Visa, Visa Electron, MasterCard, Switch and Solo. We do not accept American Express. Please consult the description of the hostel on our site to verify whether it accepts one of your credit cards to pay for the balance due upon arrival and check-in. If not, you will have to pay with cash or use any other card in cashless properties. What is the deposit? A deposit is a guarantee partial/total payment charged when you make a reservation online with us. Depending on the property you are booking and the rate you have chosen, the deposit could be the full amount of the booking or just a small percentage of it. The remaining cost of the amount of your booking is payable before or upon your arrival to the hostel. Make sure that you become acquainted with the form of payment and the credit card brands accepted, if any, by the hostel. Please consult the description of the hostel on our website. It is also important to check during the booking process if there are other charges not included in the price like taxes or other fees. Make sure you have understood the booking conditions before confirming it. Can I pay cash on arrival? Each hostel has its own payment policy. We recommend that you consult their descriptions on our website to confirm what payment methods they accept: cash, credit card or ATM debit cards Please note that you may be expected to provide a credit card or a cash deposit to cover for contingencies. Some properties could ask for a deposit at the moment of checking. The amount that appeared on my credit card statement was different to the one given to me during the reservation process. The difference is due to currency exchange rate fluctuations, between the time when you made the reservation and the time when you paid the full amount and the hostel charged it to your credit card. Although your deposit payment is charged in Euro, the booking confirmation sheet will display the balance in the currency of choice used by the property's institution. I have to cancel my reservation, what should I do? Please login to "My Account" Section and cancel your booking. To avoid additional charges, please process your cancellation before the scheduled date of arrival as per the hostel’s cancellation policy. If you do not process the cancellation on time, or you do not show up on time, your credit card will be charged the late cancellation fee. The cancellation fee details are in your confirmation email or online in "My Account" section. When you initiate the cancellation process, you should choose if you want to get a refund activating that option, if you do not enable the refund option, if your booking was refundable, a credit to your account will apply for future bookings. Credits are valid 2 years on thousands of properties. If you need to change your credit for a refund please contact us by email. If your booking was non refundable, we can not refund your booking unfortunately. We invite you to contact your travel insurance company to request a refund of the prepayments already made for your booking. Cancellation requests made by email will not be attented on time, so please do the cancellation directly on your account, and if you have any issue cancelling or accessing your account to cancel, contact us and inform the property before the cancellation period has ended. I booked the wrong type of room or the wrong dates, how can I change my reservation? To change your reservation, please login to "my account" section and made the change directly from your account. Take in consideration that not all the bookings can be modified and there are modifications that can not be done. So in order to know which modifications are possible for your booking, follow these steps 1) Log into your account in our web page. Modifications are not possible in the app. Change option will be available only if your rate allows changes and if there is availability in the property for the chosen days. Please note prices and availabilities might change at anytime and you will not be able to change your booking if it was a non refundable booking. 2) If you have not created an account in the booking process, do not worry, just reset a password using the same email you used to make the booking. Once logged, go to My bookings section, locate the booking you want to modify and there you will see the options available for modifications. For example, change dates, change number of guests or update your card. 3) If you want to modify something that is not offered, that is because that modification is not allowed by the property or by our system, so in such case, you have to keep the booking without modification or cancel it. Please take in consideration that booking with non refundable rates can not be modified at all nor canceled free of charge If I want to reduce the duration of my stay, can I apply the deposit of the unused nights towards the property bill? No, the guarantee deposit applies to the number of nights booked in the original reservation. If you change your plans and leave earlier than expected, the deposit mitigates the hostel’s loss resulting from your earlier departure. I have no confirmation, what should I do? If you don’t find our correspondence in your email inbox, please check the following: 2. Search in your email “junk folder” as it may have been screened by the spam email filter. 2. As a precaution, all the bookings that we make are also stored in our server. You may access all your bookings by login into your “My Account.” The “My Account” membership is set up automatically after your first booking with us. You can resend to your yourself booking confirmation. 3. Contact us with your booking number if you got a confirmation on the screen and you copied it or the full name /email used at the time of booking. We would also need the last four digits of the card used and the property you were trying to book. We will be happy to help you! If you have been charged, please send us an screenshot of that charge. I got an error message while waiting for the confirmation page to appear, what do I do now? There are a few reasons why your transaction may not be completed. Please contemplate the following triggers and try again. a) You may have failed to complete correctly the mandatory fields of the booking form. b) The account may not have sufficient funds to cover the transaction. c) You have not completed the confirmation process in your bank app when 3ds confirmation is required. After attending these items, please resubmit your reservation. If the error message appears again, please make a copy of the message and contact us to help you out. You can also try a different card (even if it is not a card you will take with you on your trip). It is also okay to use a card from someone else as long as you are authorized to use it. If your are going to use a card you are not taking with you in your trip, please make sure there is nothing against this on the property description. Our reservation system and credit card processing online is safe. Do I need to confirm my reservation before I arrive? There is no need to reconfirm you reservation before your arrival. Your confirmation number is your proof of reservation at the booked hostel. But if you want to contact the property to confirm it, you will find the property contact information in your confirmation email. Does the name on the credit card must be the same as on the reservation? If you do not have a credit card and someone around you allows you to use his or her card, we find no harm in processing your reservation. However, this may not be the case when you process the balance payment with the hostel. Keep in mind that if you do not show up the day of your reservation, without previously having cancelled your reservation, the credit card used will be at least charged with the full amount of your first night’s reservation but the total amount of the no show fee will depend on the property cancellation policy. I have a credit card, but I am unable to book the properties I want. Some hostels do not accept all credit cards and ATM debit cards, so this payment method may not appear when you try to select the type of card you have. What credit cards and ATM bank cards are accepted on this site? We accept Visa, Visa Delta, Visa Electron and MasterCard credit cards and Solo, Switch, JCB and Laser. However, please read the description of the hotels in our website to check if your cards are accepted when you need to deal with them. What is a double room? A double room is a private room (not dorm) for 2 people and contains 1 double bed. As a private room, the price is per room, not per guest. What is a twin room? A twin room is private room (not a dorm) for 2 people and contains 2 single beds. As a private room, the price is per room, not per guest What are dorms? Dorms are rooms you share with other customers. You book per bed, not per room. Some dorms come with a private (not shared) bathroom and/or a shower inside the dorm. Groups must book full dorms (all the beds in dorms) so they do not share the dorms with others. Properties with dorms may also offer lockers or safety deposit boxes to keep your valuables and personal belongings safe. If I travel with a young child, what kind of room would you suggest that I to book? We recommend that you book a private room (not a dorm) for both of you. There are properties, which only accept adults even in private rooms, so before confirm your booking, please read all the information and if you have any doubt please contact us. Hostels have specific policies regarding children and babies. Group bookings do not follow the same rules, generally they are flexible when children are accompanied by an adult. (please read the description of the hostel on our site for more info). What is a tent? Tents are usually limited to areas classified as campgrounds. Tents fit small beds and they generally take people from both gender groups. What is a private room? A private room is a room reserved for you and your travel companions, regardless of the number of beds available in the room. Guests who chose to reserve a private room pay for all the beds in the room, regardless if these all occupied or not. Subject to the hostel’s capacity, vacancy and the size of your group, the hostel will offer you the room that best suits your needs. What is a single room? This room type is a private room (not a dorm) and can accommodate 1 person maximum. How can I get a receipt? Your confirmation email is your receipt as well. The confirmation email is sent within 2 minute of your booking to the email entered during the reservation process. You can view, resent or forward your confirmation email/receipt anytime before your day of arrival from "My Account" section on our website. After the booking is fully paid, you can request an invoice to the property. Can I use my confirmation email for Visa process at a consulate or embassy? Yes, your confirmation email can be used as proof of your reservation for your Visa process at any consulate or embassy. If you require a confirmation email with the name of another member of your group for him/her to obtain a visa from a consulate or an embassy, please contact our service department. How do I provide a review on a property? We will automatically send you an email 20 days after your stay so you can review the hostel where you stayed. Reviews are read by all travellers and are very beneficial. Reviews are also moderated. So, if a review use inappropiate language or the guest have not stayed at the property, the review will not be approved. We take no responsibility for the reviews, feedback or the opinions expressed by the travellers who have stayed in the relevant accommodation nor are we liable for the accuracy of the information that we receive from properties. Is my information protected and private? Your personal and credit card information is fully encrypted and protected (SSL). This information will never be shared, rented or sold to any third party individual or company. How and what information do you collect from your users? We only collect personal information from users when they register online and purchase online. Generally, this information includes a name, an e-mail address, a mailing address and the information contained in the credit card transaction when purchasing products. How do you use my information? This information is used solely for internal marketing purposes. We do not sell, exchange, or disclose your personal information (name, e-mail address, mailing address, credit card data, etc.). The information that you provide us, and identifies you personally, is not shared with third parties other than for billing and mailing purpose. We only contact people who specifically have requested or opted to receive our free newsletters or who have purchased one of our products. Information about our organisation Our organisation is designed to find affordable accommodations for people who like to have fun exploring and want to fully enjoy what life has to offer in a safe manner. We are proud to say we have the best hostels booking engine on the planet. We are staffed by free-spirited, adventurous people, from a variety of backgrounds and countries, but unified by a passion to provide superior customer service. Our organisation operates without any government assistance. Our story is a continuing one. We have lots of new opportunities we are working on, which we will share with you in the near future. We are confident you will enjoy your experience with us and we thank you for your trust and support. How do I book a student accommodation with you? It’s super easy! Use the search bar on the homepage to select your city or University, choose the length of time you want to stay - September academic year or Semester, then click search. You’ll see a list and a map view of relevant student properties. Click on the property you like, fill out the enquiry form for that property and hit ‘submit’. We will contact you shortly after that with the next steps. What kind of accommodation do you have? We book accommodation all over the world for students, travellers, digital nomads, groups and anyone else who needs it . Whether you want a hostel for a night or student accommodation for a year at University we can help you research, compare and book your accommodation. Is there a booking fee that you charge if I book through you? We don’t charge our customers anything for booking with us. You will only need to pay your rent/booking. Please note, that in the case of student accomodation, the property may ask you to pay advance rent or deposit but that’s a part of your contract and rent. What other payments do I have to make to successfully book my student accommodation? You may be required to pay a deposit amount or advance rent to the property at the time of booking the accommodation (this amount is either adjusted against your rent or is returned to you after your tenancy agreement has ended. Details will be provided in your offer). This is charged by the property and the amount varies from property to property. Do I have to be a student to book with you? It depends on the property you want to book in. Some rooms/properties only offer accomodation for students, if you need specific information, please contact us. I am an International student and my visa/travel status is not confirmed. Can I still book an accommodation with you guys? Yes, you can definitely book your accommodation through us. However, we would advise you to go through the property’s cancellation policy in case your visa is denied. Most properties have a flexible cancellation policy in place for students who are not able to get their visa approved. Can I book a property with my friends? Yes, you can book an “entire place” with your friends or if you happen to apply individually then please let us know via email and we will suggest options where you can stay with your friends. Do I have to pay anything at the time of submitting my application? No, you don’t need to pay anything while submitting your application at Dorms. After we receive your application we will reach out to the property to get you an offer. For some properties, you may be required to pay advance rent/deposit at the time of signing the contract and for other properties you will be given some time to pay the first installment. What will be the duration of my tenancy? Can I choose a different tenancy period? Different properties have different options available. For some properties, you may be able to choose your tenancy duration and for other properties, there will be a fixed tenancy duration. Will you share the information about my roommate? Due to privacy concerns, landlords may refrain from sharing any confidential information about their students. Can I view the property before completing my booking? Absolutely if you have already get an offer from the property! Please send us an email at [email protected] and we will be happy to get you an appointment for the same. What is a guarantor? And can I appoint anyone to be my guarantor? A guarantor is someone who agrees to pay your rent if you don't pay it, for example a parent or close relative. If you don't pay your landlord what you owe them, they can ask your guarantor to pay instead. Yes, you can appoint anyone (your parents, relatives, guardian, family friend etc,) to be your guarantor. They will need to co-sign the agreement and will be financially responsible if you are not able to pay the rent. What if I want to cancel my contract after completing the booking? Will my rent/deposit be refunded? Please inform us as soon as you decide to cancel your student accomodation booking and we will get in touch with the property to get your cancellation initiated.
